text:
Took my cat for a checkup because she had a fever, was lethargic, and didn't eat much. Dr. Fai was very kind and gave good advice, detailed advice, and advice according to our budget. She gave many reasonable advice.

Since our cat had not been vaccinated before, it was at risk of many diseases. So the doctor recommended a general blood test and a test for feline AIDS and feline leukemia.

So our cat had many tests. After the blood test, we took our cat home and the doctor informed us of the results via Line. She was very attentive. We will take our cat to get vaccinated here again. I really like Dr. Fai.
